newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Group sees higher Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Group sees higher Q3 loss.

text.p: Interactive Group Inc said it expected earnings for its third quarter ending September to be below analysts' expectations.
The company said it foresaw a net loss between $0.08 per share and $0.11 per share for the third quarter against analysts' expectations of about $0.01 per share.
A shift of certain orders into the fourth quarter and the continuing losses of its recently acquired JIT Enterprise System product caused the company to lower its projections, it said.

The company said per share earnings for the nine-month period would likely be between $0.09 per share and $0.12 per share against $0.05 per share for the same period last year. It did not specify whether it would be a loss or a profit.
Revenues for the nine-month period are expected to be about $40 million compared to $22.7 million for the same period last year, it said.

"(Nevertheless) we remain focused on achieving our targeted operating results for the year," the company said. "In addition, while JIT continues to materially dilute company earnings, we remain on track for completing the turnaround of this strategic acquisition and anticipate achieving profitability for JIT by the first quarter of 1997."
Interactive Group, which develops, markets, implements and supports integrated business information systems, said it would release its results on October 21.
